reuse.why: Collapses the four copies of the category query into one getFillableCategories and shares a hasSavedTemplates predicate; copyPreviousMonth still works off its own budget-data query rather than the shared selection.

duplication.why: Removes three duplicated SQL blocks; the hidden rule still exists both in the shared SQL and in copyPreviousMonth's JS condition.

placement.why: The selection and predicate are private helpers in budget/actions.ts beside the actions that use them.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions and the supporting query field are touched; single-category actions are left alone.

maintainability.why: One named selection function with a clear comment makes the rule easy to find; the template rule is shared, though copyPreviousMonth applies the hidden part separately.

one_place.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts hasSavedTemplates (used by getFillableCategories for setZero/set3/6/12MonthAvg and by copyPreviousMonth); the hidden rule stays in two forms (SQL in getFillableCategories, JS in copyPreviousMonth)
